## Interfaces

claim id from `payload.claim`/`payload.claim_id` else `subject`; claim gate shells `aff verdict`/`aff recheck` and maps missing `aff` → `CloseRefused`; assertion-red shells `aff assertion-red`, maps `OracleAdapterUnavailable` → `CloseRefused`

## Assumptions

acceptances may name claims via payload fields while subject stays a task slug; Affidavit CLI on PATH for both claim and oracle gates

## Invariants

gate answers for manifest claims and assertion-level red come only through `aff` CLI; Orchestra does not import `affidavit`

## Conflicts

none on the four prior majors; skills still name `affidavit.oracle_red.is_assertion_level_red` (judgment only, omitted)
